name: PACED_MOVEMENT_V1
owner_decision: CONDITIONS-0 §4.3 (docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_CONDITIONS0_ACTOR_CONDITIONS_DECISION_2026-09-30.md, as amended by CREATURE-AI-0 §5.1); number allocated by the #1622 control plane and registered by SPEED-1; result field step_wait_ms by the owner's acceptance of OQ-1 (CLIENT-COMPLETION R1), registered by STEP-PACE-WIRE-0
offer_gate: SPEED-1: offered. It extends the result of command type 1 with STEP_DISPOSITION_TOO_EARLY = 4 and owns no command type or domain. Every player step is paced whether or not it is selected: one early step waits in a one-step buffer, and a second early request is TOO_EARLY with this capability selected and REJECTED without it. STEP-PACE-WIRE-0: the result also carries step_wait_ms (field 2), the pacing receipt: on MOVED the duration of the step just committed (a multiple of 50 ms, 50 to 111,150), on TOO_EARLY the milliseconds left until the server deadline, rounded up (1 to 111,150), never on BLOCKED or REJECTED. It is written only when non-zero, and it is not state (no revision, no snapshot). Without this capability selected, field 2 fails closed and the command type 1 result is at most 4 bytes; the command type 1 max_result_payload_bytes is the bound under this capability.
